user.title: Multi-Agent Router Configuration
user.description:
{status}

Configure all required components before submitting.

edit_prompt_ai.title: Configure Prompt AI
edit_prompt_ai.description: Select the conversation agent that generates routing prompts and configure its system prompt.

data_description.prompt_generator_agent: Agent that generates routing prompts using AI
data_description.prompt_generator_prompt: The system prompt for the generator. Use {agent_json} as placeholder for agent data.

edit_router_ai.title: Configure Router AI
edit_router_ai.description: Select the conversation agent that will route user requests. The routing prompt will be generated automatically by the Prompt AI.

data_description.agent: The conversation agent that routes requests to specialized agents

add_custom_ai.title: Add Custom AI
add_custom_ai.description: Configure a specialized conversation agent that the router can direct requests to.

data_description.name: Friendly name for this agent (e.g., 'Jarvis Think', 'Home Control')
data_description.description: Describe what types of requests this agent should handle (e.g., 'Handles questions and analysis')
data_description.agent_keywords: Comma-separated keywords to help the router classify requests (e.g., 'question, what, why, how')
data_description.agent_prompt: Custom system prompt for this agent. Will be auto-filled from agent's current prompt if available.

select_edit_custom_ai.title: Select Custom AI to Edit
select_edit_custom_ai.description: Choose which custom agent to edit.

edit_custom_ai_form.title: Edit Custom AI
edit_custom_ai_form.description: Update the configuration for this custom agent.

data_description.name: Friendly name for this agent
data_description.description: Describe what types of requests this agent should handle
data_description.agent_keywords: Comma-separated keywords to help the router classify requests
data_description.agent_prompt: Custom system prompt for this agent

select_delete_custom_ai.title: Delete Custom AI
select_delete_custom_ai.description: Select an agent to remove from the configuration.

review_prompt.title: Review Router Prompt
review_prompt.description: Review the AI-generated router prompt. You can edit it before final submission.

data_description.agent_prompt: The routing prompt that will be applied to the Router AI. This was generated by your Prompt AI based on your Custom AIs.

error.no_agents: You must configure at least one specialized agent.
error.no_custom_agents: At least one Custom AI must be configured before submitting.
error.duplicate_name: An agent with this name already exists. Please choose a different name.
error.invalid_agent: The selected agent does not exist.
error.missing_prompt_ai: Prompt AI must be configured before submitting.
error.missing_router_ai: Router AI must be configured before submitting.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only a single instance is allowed.
abort.no_agents: No conversation agents found. Please configure conversation agents (like OpenAI Conversation, Extended OpenAI Conversation, etc.) before setting up Multi-Agent Router.
abort.no_custom_agents: At least one Custom AI must be configured.
